dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what's with the shop if you're not selling?

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: Ha, that's a good one. Whoever said that a shop must needs hawk wares?

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: I bought this store here precisely to show these beauties off to any who would pass by.

dialogues.speaker: Tai
dialogues.text: Every day, some ignorant bystanders like you will come by and ask me these questions. That said, this is precisely what I want...
